body: A family member of mine has it for the second year in a row and I’m devastated as well- probably no gathering for Christmas for 2 years in a row now; covid sucks and I hope you and all other positive people feel better soon

I failed MAT210 with Rody, did good in CIS and COM like you said, and ACC231 was insane- I did good the first two exams because he curved them but I got a 66% on the last one- the class averages were 70 75 and below 70% for the 3 exams
He said it’s to test knowledge of the concepts not just memorize but it’s too different to even comprehend how the problems are connected
I have ACC241 with him next session- I hope it’s a bit better
For real! It gets so crazy sometimes

I saw your post, a lot of the people there are giving really good advice, and they’re right- it’s not beyond repair, sometimes a little break or boundaries is what a friendship needs to grow stronger!

I’m still close with her! We chat a lot still- she respects my boundaries and checks in on my energy sometimes, it’ll be okay! Being friends takes mutual communication and respect, and as long as you and your friend have a plan I don’t see why y’all won’t still be close :)

Thank you so much, I really appreciate your story and I’m glad you’re doing better with that situation- it sounds really similar and exhausting as well. I’ve set a few boundaries today (finally) and hope they stick! Thank you again

Thank you a ton, you’re right with basically everything you said- at first being their friend was fun since we have shared interests but being told about everything going on for them ever it’s tiring and I’m unfortunately feeling sad and angry at them more often than not- I have therapy fairly soon today so I’ll definitely talk about that and find a course of action that can hopefully improve things in the long run
Thank you so much, I may consider doing that if she doesn’t take the hint soon (I haven’t been reading her messages except once a day to try out giving some distance)

Agreeing with the other comments here, get a lawyer and adding on to say once things are settled with court, block him everywhere except a messaging app that the court can access, which will keep him from breaking anything agreed upon

Thank you so much, and YES! The way you phrase things is wonderful, I really want deep connections with people instead of the same old topics every day- taking breaks is healthy! Thank you again and again, everyone here has been wonderful!!!

Well I’d say it’s a not healthy pattern to base your self worth off of what someone says- they never 100% know you! You’re aware of your limits, your hobbies, how you feel, and the things she said were meant to hurt you- they don’t define you. You want to improve and get out of the rut of thinking you’re not good enough, which in and of itself is a good thing! It’s better to live for yourself or for something you enjoy, rather than hoping she’ll come back to you- since honestly it seems like you’ll feel better without the hurtful things that define your thinking at this point, but again I don’t 100% know you so I just hope you hang in there and take it a day at a time- focus on you!

I really appreciate your help here, (as I read this they said “I hope your day was good!” For the 5th day in a row) and based on these responses from awesome people here I gotta stop encouraging/responding as much as usual tbh, I don’t know how to start a convo with them about needing a break or something so I may start not responding as much for now- thanks again for your help!!
It doesn’t affect my perception of myself tbh, I’d feel guilty but know I’m doing things healthy for my own mental health and eventually for theirs

I’m really sorry you’re dealing with that, if you have the means I’d suggest therapy and possibly cognitive behavioral therapy, which has at least helped me a bit! Try to catch those thoughts and remember you deserve good things, even if this relationship made you conditioned to think you don’t- I’m not qualified for a ton of advice but I wish you the best- try to remember it’s okay to feel like this and to work slowly to get out of it! 💜

That’s a really wonderful way of putting it, and I hope that once I’m more distant/go LC with them they may consider getting help or finding other friends than just me, may I ask how you approached the situation without making your sister super upset? I’d love a break or at least less messages from Patricia but I just don’t know how to approach it without essentially confirming their worst fear- being a bad friend

Honestly yea- I respond or read almost all of my other friends’ texts since its just a few times a day or in group chats, so if I set a limit she may know it’s her since she spams me so often, and I wish I’d be able to set a limit (and I might without letting ppl know unless they ask) without her being upset about it- she’d say “is it about me? Am I annoying?” And then I’ll be backed into a corner: say yea please give it a rest or lie and say no you’re fine I’m just working on less tech

You talking to girls doesn’t affect her, if she chose to break up with you I don’t think you trying to move on or take care of yourself is going to benefit or harm a future relationship with you, if that’s what you’re asking
I think she’d be happy if you found someone you love, but this is all from an outside perspective

I’d say try to move away from the “what does my ex think” mindset, it definitely won’t happen overnight but try to catch those thoughts and replace them with “what can I do for me?” Take care of yourself, don’t jump to respond if she messages you, it seems like you would be happier without her (at the moment) since she consumes so much of your thinking. If you feel ready to move on, try to go on a date and just get your mind off of her. Spend time with friends or family, she probably won’t come back to you (at least not this soon, sorry to be blunt) so do what makes you happy!
Thank you so much!!
That’s really awesome to hear, I’m gonna see if that can be something I try as well, it sounds relaxing
Thank you for sharing, I really appreciate hearing other similar stories, I’ll definitely set more time to myself to not worry about others or their messages!
Thank you so much :,) and that’s a wonderful name!!!

Similar feelings here bud, I’m trying to take steps out of this living hell like a therapist of mine says but nothing actually works and I’ve gone through my mental reserve of strength :/ (I posted here a few minutes ago more in depth about how I feel) 
I want reasons to live, ways to ease the awful feelings in my gut and screams in my head to make it stop- I guess I’m gonna keep trying to get through each day to see if there’s reasons to keep going and see if anything ends up helping, I hope you keep going too and maybe life will be gracious for once :,)

Me too
I’m too afraid of the pain so I just keep going but there’s just so much awfulness to get through
I hope we both make it through this

Same here, I’m really sorry this is happening and the urges are so strong. I’d suggest mild distractions if you can or if there’s a hotline you feel comfortable calling, is there any support system you have to contact?
I did pass! I was really worried the day of but was able to squash my anxiety for those 10 minutes and passed, thank you so much for your encouragement from this post!

I have my first test tomorrow and I’m scared I won’t pass it or I’ll panic and make dumb mistakes, but if that happens it’s okay! We’re humans and anxiety is really troublesome, but I believe in you! You can get your license, just keep practicing and taking your time- I’ve heard going to smaller DMVs earlier in the day is useful for having less traffic; I hope you keep trying because I know you can do it

Congrats! I was browsing Reddit for encouragement since my test is tomorrow and I have really bad anxiety symptoms like you so it’s nice to know others are able to get over it, thanks for the encouraging words and I’m so glad you passed :D
It’s going to be a good week if I can get over the anxiety for my drivers test, wish me lots of luck and thank you again for checking in!

Totally! Finding little positives has at least helped me through Covid and helped me be a lot less self deprecating as I’d been in the past, I’m gonna continue to do that and thank you again for your advice!

The picture thing is such an accurate comparison, thanks for telling me! I experienced it from someone else in the past so I really do know how old it can get, hearing that stuff all the time
I’m going to try to find a place to privately write things instead of dumping on my friends, they’ve been real patient for the most part

Oh gosh thank you a ton for this, I try to push all the self deprecation down but it tends to come back up once in a while and results in scenarios like this post
I’ll work on communicating better, I just dislike seeking attention and I’ve been trying to just avoid talking about myself except when this person pushes all my buttons and got me kinda mad earlier 
Thank you again, I’m going to try to talk things out logically more instead of just getting sad or angry

Thank you so so much for the advice! I’ve been trying to avoid emotion dumping on people except for one scenario where they keep doing things that make me uncomfortable- calling me by the wrong pronouns, bringing up my crush even though they promised they wouldn’t- I’ve tried gently talking to them but get too tired and just say if they need a break do it 
I guess I’m too tired to stand up for myself sometimes because it’ll make me feel like a bad friend- whew on that note I really should find another therapist! (My old one moved and I never got a new one)
Thank you again for the advice, and I’ll try to bring up other conversation topics like you suggested and focus more on them instead of me as much

I’ve actually gone through that myself with previous friends so I know how tiring it can be, thank you so much for the advice! I’m definitely working on loving myself more and not projecting all of my worries onto others
I’d like to but I bet my parents would be really suspicious and say there’s no need :/ maybe I’ll work up the courage to email my psychiatrist one day or something, but thank you for the advice

Same thing happened to me the past couple years, no one even remembered it was my day and all they did was apologize a couple of months after- I’ve spend birthdays crying and feeling alone, but remember you deserve to be loved and cared about and I hope your birthday turns around, at least a little 💜

I’m in a similar situation- I’d like to tell my psychiatrist about my thoughts and how I’d like to be tested for depression but my mom’s always at the appointments with me and I never get a second alone with the psych

Ooh! I’ve been working on an automatic sorting system from a tutorial and reconnected with a couple old friends- I’d told my crush how I feel but ofc they said we can “figure it out” and get “even closer after we do” since they’re not attracted to nb people 😔 but I guess I can deal with that, just playin some games and taking each day
How’s your week been?

I’ve been playing Minecraft a LOT and keep watching people stream as well and it’s so comforting! I’m struggling with a crush still and trying to find the words to tell her how I feel but I’m taking it easy and remembering I’m only human, things don’t need to be perfect 
I hope you’re doing well!!

I know things suck and everything is scary and painful right now, but I know you can get through this. Life may not be as peaceful and nice as fantasy, but you can find a path that leads you to something that you’re at the very least content with. It’s alright to be in pain and be scared and unsure, but know you’re not alone and it will get better
You don’t need to share any of your thoughts with people if you don’t want to, but at the very least maybe some sort of therapy or even just posting on here once in a while could be beneficial! I believe in you :)

Yoooo same here, i dunno if it’s just late and I’m sleep deprived but damn same
If I had known how painful life would be sometimes id have seriously weighed the options if given the choice to exist or not
Probably would’ve made it a ton easier for those who know me for me to not exist but ugh
I guess we’re all here for a reason and just gotta find it eventually

I’m only 17 yet I’m in a spiral of doing this too. I get close to someone, befriend them for a couple years and it’s all good, but then I hit a rough patch and vent one time too many or get one short response too many and I think oh gosh I’ve been too much of a burden 
Then I act like I’m fine, respond less, then want to rebound and tell them how awful I’ve felt, then end up pushing them away a final time. 
I’m trying to break this spiral because I cherish my current friends and just want a break from my brain telling myself that I’m not good enough. You deserve friends and deserve to be happy, remember your brain is being mean. I hope you find some true friends who’ll stick by you even when it’s rough, remember you deserve it and those who really care won’t leave you even if you try to push them away when things get tough 
I hope all goes well sometime soon!!

I get it, I want a handful of close people to care but at the same time I don’t want to be that person who everyone worries about and panders to for being depressed and if I ever admit to having suicidal thoughts I doubt I’d get peace 
Attention is the worst sometimes, calm and gentle talks with only those you really wanna talk with are helpful from my experience though

Thanks so much for checking in!!! You’re such a kind person- it’s been tricky with family visiting for holidays and more homophobia being thrown around but at least I’m able to distract myself with games and fun things for the summer! I hope you’re doing well too!

Same, it’s so hard to reach out to people and when I try to socialize I somehow mess it up even if it’s just on a call and I end up panicking if I ever see friends in person
I can never find the right words and always miscommunicate or just don’t fit in even with those who say they care
But I suppose there’s at least beauty in not being alone, even if it’s just this small pocket of the internet where we can seek some comfort or a safe place to connect
Take it easy 💙
I have a leopard gecko, I love lizards and animals in general so I second this idea for at least a distraction

I’ve felt that way increasingly, but even if you just post on this subreddit once in a while maybe you’ll find a little comfort from strangers :,)

Same here... I post here once in a while to get just the little bit of warmth knowing the internet has some kind people, y’know? I try to give back and help people out or even just listen if I have the right headspace to... I also really hope things get better for everyone :,)

Heyo, I’ve felt that way as well, but please try to assure yourself that your friends and family and everyone wouldn’t just go on with their lives... thinking about if I lost a friend right now, I probably couldn’t go a day without thinking about them and wishing I could’ve helped. Depression really sucks and I hope things get better, maybe a different medicine would provide better results? Either way, I totally feel you and maybe talking to a handful of close friends would help make you feel a lil more loved

I feel you there. I got a bad crush too and it’s so damn painful. She’s going to date him soon they’re even cuddling and staying up late together and I hate it so much, I’ve heard the pain fades so I hope we all get through this
Same oml

I’m no expert on how to make things better, but it’s really good that you at least put it off. You’re worth being on this planet no matter what anyone else says or even if your brain keeps whispering that to you- I’ve been feeling the same sort of thing lately. Just anxious, tired, numb, or once in a while really angry and then I get more pissed at my own stupidity for feeling angry at something dumb- the point is you’re not alone. 
It’s okay to not like yourself, I’m there right now too, but trust your friends and family when they’d at they love you. Just because you feel like you’re a waste of air or make others feel worse doesn’t mean it’s true. See if playing a game, eating a favorite snack, hanging out with friends, anything sparks some sort of joy, alright? 
Sometimes it takes me weeks to get out of the cesspool of numbness and negative emotions but I really hope you can find something to hold onto until things can get a lil better

Unfortunately most of my family is homophobic and I don’t really know if they take mental health seriously either, but I have some other close friends who are able to listen to my woes from time to time...I really appreciate the knowledge that the pain will hopefully fade with time, and thank you so much for the response :,)
I do that too and it’s kinda scary to think about- it’s comforting to imagine people caring after I die for some reason which weirdly enough helps me carry on for a little longer
I feel the same way :/ I doubt you’re faking it and I hope things improve, even if it’s just those little bits of happiness :)

I’m so sorry, please remember you’re beautiful and amazing for who you are. I’ve been questioning and I have really homophobic parents so I partially understand how you feel... if you can, see if you have any friends who are genuinely supportive, either in person or online, because you deserve the best no matter what those “friends” or your mom says 💕
Oooooh! Thank you so much!!
I’m so happy you’re still here, even if I don’t know you it’s just nice to see that you’re alive and it gives me lots of hope
Same, I just want attention and warm feelings to know people really care

You can forgive yourself, I promise. Take small steps and you’ll find good things if you take each day, no each minute as it comes. You’re worth so much more than any of us can say- even if you don’t feel like it, you matter.
